  > One request, Table 3 (`tab:rule`, appendix): `results/predictive_rule.csv` has new rows from experiment-repo (1457fbf), the C5 reference predictors, on the same held-out units:

Please add them to Table 3 after the design-term rows, labelled in words: "held-out RMSE, mean only", "log z only", "regression (base)", "same-graph null mean at the pair's z", "first-order estimate rescaled by its median bias", with the squared-error difference to the base model and its interval. They change what the text says (the regression is no better than the null mean for deletion, and worse than the rescaled first-order estimate for flips), so they need to be visible, not only in the CSV.
